skin.source: tools/scarlet_skin.mjs: the user's own skin (11-05), bytes written unchanged
skin.layout: player avatar (tools/build_player_rig.mjs bodyModels = tools/arlecchino_geometry.mjs P1_SPECS) with its slim 3-px arms (the user's skin is a slim skin)
skin._doc: map: model -> [region, row start, row end] (the base box shows the region's base layer, the second box its outer layer, inflated on all six sides). specs: the avatar's box specs (from / to in model units about the pivot [8, 8, 8], uv / over = [u, v, w, h, d], rows start..end). hidden: parts the skin already shows (model empty, scale 0). face_overlays: [col, row, cols, rows] of the 8 x 8 face painted by face_fx.

icon._doc: F-I (HR-03): items/item_sword.json selects on display_context: these contexts show the icon model (drawn in GUI px), every other one (the hands, item_display none) the rig model

skeleton._doc: the player avatar's skeleton (blocks; rig frame +X her left, +Y up, -Z forward): hip_y = the hip line at pos 0; waist = the torso pivot (the seam, body row 9) from the hip line; neckB / shoulder from the seam; armU / fore = shoulder -> elbow -> grip; thigh / shin = hip joint -> knee -> the outer-layer sole

patches.why: the floor pickup of the hat on the right knee
the sword out at her left through the kneel (5- / 6-tick ramps: no whip)
the floor pickup of the hat on the right knee
the sword out at her left through the kip and the kneel (a 5-tick ramp in; out over 6 ticks after the kneel: no whip, the elbow never crosses the shoulder)
the cross-draw reach to the hip hilt
the sheathe entry on the new scabbard axis (SH0')
the feet step with seq.py's 1.1-b glide aside off the seat stone (4 side steps of 0.55 b, the stance sole kept on its world spot)

retarget._doc: per sample: retarget (angles kept; pos x k(lf); soles about the hip joint x S_LEG; grip distances x S_ARM + the lock rule; planted hands x S_LEG; scOff x S_SCAB; world-hat spots) -> overlay (PATCHES, the hat hand-overs, the flights) -> solve. clips: per clip the solver passes, the largest value of every correction guard (degrees, or cm for drop / bPush / close / hatBackZ / hatPush / hatClear, percent for armUp; +/- = the two senses), the largest contact distance per kind, the largest IK stretch, the blade residue inside the body (b), the largest support move and lift
